svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: ToolTrie-v1 holds the outer throughput–interactivity frontier at Qwen3-0.6B
Dots: one per request, over its 40-request window. Lines: run medians per offered rate. Brackets: ToolTrie-v1 vs no reordering.
interactivity: responses per second per user (1 / time to first token)
Offered rates 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 2.75, 3.0 req/s, 200 requests each (3,839 dots). Each dot is the 40 requests that finished nearest to one request: median
interactivity and completion rate over that window. The first and last 20 completions per run lack a full window. Bracket gaps are read off the
median lines by linear interpolation. Source: cluster/results/eval-validity-20260906-165826.
